crossRefs.note: If a wise man goes to court with a foolish man, the fool rages or scoffs, and there is no peace.
The people will be oppressed, everyone by another, and everyone by his neighbor. The child will behave himself proudly…
Therefore subject yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake: whether to the king, as supreme;
or to governors, as sent by him for vengeance on evildoers and for praise to those who do well.
Yet in the same way, these also in their dreaming defile the flesh, despise authority, and slander celestial beings.
